blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them. As a result, tool interfaces may not match real ones, tool compositions are not grounded in execution, and tasks rarely span more than one environment. We propose ToolSpace, a tool-centric framework that reverses this order. ToolSpace mines data, state, and retry dependencies from adjacent calls in execution traces of real MCP services and open agent corpora, using deterministic rules rather than LLM judgment, and clusters the resulting weighted tool-composition graph into environments. Databases are synthesized only for state-mutating environments, while query and stateless tools replay recorded returns. ToolSpace then performs state-aware random walks with rollback and decompiles each chain into a natural-language task with assertion-based checks, keeping only samples that replay successfully from the initial state. Applied to AutomationBench and tau3-Bench Banking, the pipeline produces harder Pro versions on which 7 frontier models drop by up to 38.2 points. Across seven long-horizon tool-use benchmarks, ToolSpace raises Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from 23.0 to 41.0 average score (43.2 with RL) and GLM-5.2 from 44.6 to 56.6, on par with Claude Opus 5. Ablations show that execution-witnessed edges clearly outperform LLM-judged ones, and performance keeps improving with data and environment scale.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型作为长视距代理被部署,将跨MCP服务的各种工具编成可执行的工作流程. 现有的MCP环境尺度方法以数据为中心:它们首先合成一个数据库和情景,然后从中获取工具和任务. 因此,工具接口可能不匹配真实的接口,工具构成不基于执行,任务很少跨越一个以上的环境. 我们提出"工具空间",一个以工具为中心的框架来扭转这个顺序. ToolSpace矿井数据、状态和重试来自相邻电话的依赖性,使用确定性规则而不是LLM判断,在真实的MCP服务和开源代理公司的执行痕迹中将由此产生的加权工具组合图组合到环境中。 数据库只针对状态变换环境进行合成,而查询和无国籍工具则重放记录的返回. ToolSpace然后以回滚方式进行状态意识随机行走,将每个链条分解为自然语言任务,并进行基于断言的检查,只保留从初始状态中成功重播的样本. 该管道适用于自动化奔驰和Tau3-奔驰银行业务,生产更硬的Pro版本,7个前沿型号下降最多38.2点. 在7个长视距工具使用基准中,TollectSpace将Qwen3.6-35B-A3B从23.0提高到41.0平均分(43.2与RL),GLM-5.2从44.6提高到56.6,与Claude Opus 5. 差距表明,被处决的目击证人的优势明显高于LLM判断的优势,而且随着数据和环境尺度的扩大,性能不断提高。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances have extended large language models (LLMs) from single-turn chatbots to collaborative agents that complete long-horizon tasks in dynamic environments ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Qin et al., 2023 ; Patil et al., 2023 ) . Such agents must not only master a scalable tool set, but also orchestrate diverse tools into executable long-horizon chains. Because tools are the atomic units of agent execution, how tools are organized and composed at scale has become a foundational question for expanding agent capability ( Li et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Anthropic, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 近期的进步将大型语言模型(LLMs)从单回合聊天机器人扩展到在动态环境中完成长视野任务的合作代理(姚等人,2023年;史克等人,2023年;秦等人,2023年;帕蒂尔等人,2023年). 这些代理人不仅必须掌握一套可扩展的工具,还必须将各种工具编织成可执行的长视链。 由于工具是物剂执行的原子单位,工具的组织和构成规模如何成为扩大物剂能力的基础问题(Li等人,2023年;Song等人,2023年;徐等人,2025年;Anthropic,2024年).

blocks.en: To scale tool use, recent work follows two main routes. One family, exemplified by Simia ( Li et al., 2025 ) and GenEnv ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , treats the LLM as an implicit textual world model and generates simulated feedback from tool specifications and interaction histories. These methods are inexpensive, but their feedback is prone to hallucination and state consistency is difficult to guarantee. The second family explicitly reproduces interaction logic by synthesizing executable tools together with environment databases: it extracts or constructs an underlying database from a real service theme, generates matching tools, and synthesizes tasks with verifiable outcomes ( Song et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2026a ; Fang et al., 2025 ) . Later systems further evolve whole interaction stacks or repair environments from execution feedback ( Mao et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 为了扩大工具的使用范围,最近的工作遵循两个主要路线。 一个家族以Simia(Li等人,2025年)和GenEnv(Guo等人,2025年)为例,将LLM视为隐含的文字世界模型,并从工具规格和互动历史中产生模拟反馈. 这些方法成本低廉,但其反馈容易产生幻觉,状态一致性难以保证. 第二家族通过合成可执行工具与环境数据库,明确复制交互逻辑:它从一个真实的服务主题中提取或构建一个基础数据库,生成匹配工具,并以可核实的结果综合任务(Song等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年;Dong等人,2026年a;Fang等人,2025年). 后来的系统进一步从执行反馈(Mao等人,2026年;He等人,2026年;Dong等人,2026年b)进化出整个相互作用堆栈或修复环境.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, existing paradigms still follow Data-Centric Environment Synthesis : synthesize the underlying database and thematic scenario first, and only then derive tools and tasks. This ordering has three inherent limitations: • Tool–functionality mismatch. Executable tools are synthesized from the environment database and theme description, so their parameter logic easily diverges from real tool interface definitions. Agents consequently learn a synthetic tool protocol rather than operations transferable to a real tool ecosystem. • Inauthentic tool orchestration. Existing work builds tool-link graphs and synthesizes tasks through random linking or shallow LLM judgments, so the resulting links lack authenticity. Real tool services are moreover unstable and noisy, and their logical relations are hard to establish subjectively. • Lack of cross-environment task synthesis. Current task synthesis relies on the data and rules of a single environment, whereas real-world tasks routinely span several environments. Because tools are locked inside their own sandboxes, cross-environment composition has no explicit reachability relation, and long-horizon complexity cannot grow naturally.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,但现有的范式仍然遵循数据-科学环境综合:首先综合基础数据库和专题情景,然后才获得工具和任务。 此命令有三个内在的局限性: ^ Tool–功能不匹配. 从环境数据库和主题描述中合成可执行工具,因此其参数逻辑很容易与真正的工具界面定义发生差异. 因此,代理人学习的是合成工具协议,而不是可移植到真正工具生态系统的操作。 • 非正当工具组织。 现有工作通过随机链接或浅 LLM 判断来构建工具链接图,并合成任务,因此由此产生的链接缺乏真实性. 此外,真正的工具服务不稳定和吵闹,其逻辑关系难以主观确定。 • 缺乏跨环境任务的综合。 目前的任务综合依赖于单一环境的数据和规则,而现实世界的任务通常跨越若干环境。 由于工具被锁在自己的沙盒内,跨环境成分没有明显的可达性关系,长视复杂度不能自然增长.

blocks.en: Together, these limitations share a single root cause: Data-Centric Environment Synthesis presumes a realistically synthesized environment and derives tool composition from it, reversing the dependency that governs real agent execution. How to synthesize agent training data that preserves real tool orchestration across diverse environments therefore remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh: 这些限制加在一起,只有一个根源: 数据-化学环境综合假设一种现实的合成环境,并从中获取工具组成,扭转了制约实际代理执行的依赖性。 因此,如何综合能够保持不同环境之间真正工具协调的代理人培训数据,仍然是一个公开的挑战。

blocks.en: Our starting point is that, within agent execution, tools are the atomic units of capability growth, not static environment data . As illustrated in Figure 1 (a)–(b), a Tool Space that has not yet been explicitly modeled always lies between an agent and its underlying environment databases, and the relations among tools naturally connect an extensible environment ecosystem. A natural path is therefore to model the real connectivity and state transfer among tools, and to build a cross-environment tool-graph layer on top of these relations. The complexity of synthesized tasks then arises from expanding the real tool-composition space, rather than from the data scale of any single environment.
blocks.zh: 我们的出发点是,在物剂执行中,工具是能力增长的原子单位,而不是静态环境数据。 如图1(a)-(b)所示,一个尚未明确建模的工具空间总是位于一种物剂及其基本环境数据库之间,工具之间的关系自然将一个可扩展的环境生态系统联系起来。 因此,一条自然道路就是模拟工具之间的真正连接和状态转移,并在这些关系之上建立一个跨环境工具图层. 然后,综合任务的复杂性产生于扩大真正的工具组合空间,而不是来自任何单一环境的数据尺度。

blocks.en: Following this insight, we propose ToolSpace , a tool-centric framework for cross-environment agent data synthesis. Unlike Data-Centric Environment Synthesis, ToolSpace does not mine a new environment ecosystem from scratch; it follows a Trace-to-ENV principle ( Long et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) : it first reconstructs a scalable, explorable tool space from execution traces, then synthesizes long-horizon agent tasks across the tool and environment clusters connected in this space. ToolSpace consists of two stages:
blocks.zh: 根据这一认识,我们提出“工具空间”,作为跨环境物剂数据合成的工具中心框架。 与数据-Centric Environment Synthesis不同,ToolSpace并不从零开始埋下一个新的环境生态系统;它遵循了Trace-to-ENV原则(Long等人,2026年;Wu等人,2026年) :它首先从执行痕迹中重建一个可伸缩,可扩展的工具空间,然后从这个空间连接的工具和环境集群中合成长视代理任务. 工具空间包括两个阶段:

blocks.en: • Tool Space Exploration. We extract tool calls from real-world execution traces and mine data, state, and retry links with deterministic rules, building a scalable tool-composition graph. Tightly coupled tools are clustered into environment clusters; an underlying database is synthesized on demand only for operation environments, while original tool returns are reused directly otherwise. This preserves tool-composition relationships while substantially reducing environment synthesis cost. • Cross-Environment Verifiable Task Synthesis. Over the ToolSpace graph, State-Aware Random Walks with Rollback Sampling sample state-compatible successors by edge weight and execute them step by step, retaining only chains that execute end to end under runtime-observed state transitions. Each retained walk is then decompiled into a natural-language task with assertion-based verification scripts, yielding training samples that can be replayed and audited across environments.
blocks.zh: • 空间探索工具。 我们从现实世界的行刑痕迹和地雷数据中提取工具呼叫, 状态,和重试链接 与决定性规则, 构建一个可缩放的工具组合图。 紧密结合的工具被组合成环境集群;一个基础数据库仅根据运行环境的需求进行合成,而原始工具返回则直接以其他方式重复使用. 这保留了工具组合关系,同时大幅度降低了环境合成成本. • 跨环境 可验证的任务综述. 在"工具空间图"上,国家-Aware Random Walks 与 Rollback Sampling 样本的状态相容后按边重进行并逐步执行,仅保留在运行时观察状态过渡下执行结束的链条. 然后,每个保留行走被分解成自然语言任务,并配有基于断言的核查脚本,产生培训样本,可在各种环境中重新播放和审计。

The upgraded versions exceed the standard ones in task difficulty and number of environments crossed. On AutomationBench Pro, seven frontier models drop by up to 38.2 points relative to the standard version (Figure 1 ).

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows: • We identify limits of data-centric synthesis: reverse-synthesized tools mismatch real tool semantics, tool graphs lack execution evidence, and tasks are confined to single-environment complexity; and we then propose Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis . • We propose ToolSpace, which reconstructs a scalable, explorable tool-composition space from real execution traces and synthesizes long-horizon, verifiable agent tasks across diverse tool and environment combinations within this space. • We show that ToolSpace plugs into long-horizon tool-use benchmarks, producing AutomationBench Pro and τ 3 \tau^{3} -Bench Banking Pro, which exceed their standard versions in difficulty, tool-call turns, and cross-environment breadth. • Across seven long-horizon tool-use benchmarks, experiments demonstrate clear advantages across model scales (8B–744B). ToolSpace-744B-A40B surpasses GPT 5.6 Sol in average score (56.6 vs. 48.9) and matches Claude Opus 5. Further analyses reveal clear scaling relationships of data scale, environment scale, and task diversity with agent performance.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Agent Environment Scaling. Agent Environment Scaling has become an important foundation for the evolution of agent capabilities, by scaling the environments in which agents act. Simulator-style methods, exemplified by Simia ( Li et al., 2025 ) and GenEnv ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , use an LLM as a textual world model to emulate tool feedback: cheap to scale, but prone to hallucination and state inconsistency. Executable-environment methods instead synthesize databases, tools, and verifiable tasks programmatically ( Song et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2026a ; Fang et al., 2025 ) , with later variants that evolve environments or whole interaction systems ( He et al., 2026 ; Mao et al., 2026 ) or repair them from execution feedback ( Dong et al., 2026b ) . In all of these, the unit of scaling remains the environment (or the surrounding harness), so which tools may compose is fixed before any task is drawn. ToolSpace is complementary: it recovers tool-composition structure witnessed by executions and synthesizes databases only on demand, so the same machinery can upgrade benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 代理环境扩展。 代理人环境扩展通过扩大代理人行动的环境,成为代理人能力演变的重要基础. Simia (Li et al., 2025)和GenEnv (Guo et al., 2025)所举例说明的模拟器风格方法,使用LLM作为文字世界模型来模拟工具反馈:廉价的尺度,但容易产生幻觉和状态不一致. 可执行环境方法转而在方案上综合数据库,工具和可核查的任务(Song等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年;Dong等人,2026a年;Fang等人,2025年),后期变体会演化环境或整个相互作用系统(He等人,2026年;Mao等人,2026年),或从执行反馈中修复(Dong等人,2026b年). 在所有这些方面,缩放的单位仍然是环境(或周围的绳索),因此,在绘制任何任务之前,可以固定哪些工具。 ToolSpace是互补的:它恢复了被处决所见证的工具组合结构,并且只根据需要综合数据库,因此同样的机器可以升级基准.

blocks.en: Graph-Based Agentic Data Synthesis. Building agent data with intrinsic dependencies on structured graphs is a promising direction. For search and knowledge agents, prior work builds knowledge graphs or formalizes information seeking tasks to generate hard questions and trajectories ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Tao et al., 2025 ) . For general tool use, function-signature or API-dependency graphs are walked to produce multi-turn calls and verified blueprints ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Prabhakar et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2026a ) ; similar recipes reverse-synthesize trajectories for multimodal GUI and web agents ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . These chains then feed SFT, agentic RL, and reflection-style training ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Dong et al., 2026b ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . ToolSpace differs in where the graph comes from and what it guarantees: edges are mined by deterministic rules from adjacent real calls ( Qin et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) across environments, typed as data, state, or retry and weighted by witnessed frequency; a walk enters training only after replay from s 0 s_{0} passes state, trace, and output checks. ToolSpace is the framework to make witnessed tool composition the single primitive behind cross-environment tasks and benchmarks.

blocks.en: Overview. We present ToolSpace , a tool-centric framework for cross-environment agent data synthesis (Figure 2 ). ToolSpace comprises two tightly coupled components, detailed below, and seamlessly raises the difficulty of existing environment benchmarks (§ 5 ): • Tool Space Exploration (§ 4.1 ) extracts tool calls from real traces, mines data/state/retry dependencies by rules, builds a tool-composition graph, clusters tools into environments, and synthesizes a database only for operation-bearing clusters. • Cross-Environment Task Synthesis (§ 4.2 ) explores executable long-horizon chains by State-Aware Random Walks and decompiles them into tasks with verification scripts, retaining only samples that replay from s 0 s_{0} and pass all checks.

blocks.en: MCP-ecosystem trajectories. Existing MCP environment scaling work ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2026a ) typically synthesizes task queries over real MCP servers from registries such as Smithery. For adjacent calls ( f t , x t , o t ) (f_{t},x_{t},o_{t}) and ( f t + 1 , x t + 1 , o t + 1 ) (f_{t+1},x_{t+1},o_{t+1}) in a trajectory, we extract three edge types by deterministic rules, no LLM judgment is used : • Data dependency ( v t → data v t + 1 ) (v_{t}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{data}}v_{t+1}) : the input x t + 1 x_{t+1} uses a value from o t o_{t} and field types match. Concrete data is passed. • State dependency ( v t → state v t + 1 ) (v_{t}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{state}}v_{t+1}) : the first call mutates an environment object and the second call reads or further mutates the same object , not merely a coincidentally equal value. • Retry dependency ( v t → retry v t + 1 ) (v_{t}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{retry}}v_{t+1}) : the first call returns an error, the trajectory switches tools, and the next call succeeds. blocks.en: Benchmark Construction. For a benchmark b b with original environment e b orig = ( 𝒟 b orig , ℱ b orig ) e_{b}^{\mathrm{orig}}=(\mathcal{D}_{b}^{\mathrm{orig}},\mathcal{F}_{b}^{\mathrm{orig}}) , we collect its real tool calls ℳ b \mathcal{M}_{b} , build a tool graph 𝒢 b \mathcal{G}_{b} by the rules of § 4.1.2 , and thereby link in tools outside the original benchmark that share data or state relations with benchmark tools, expanding a single environment into a cross-environment cluster. We then restore or synthesize the necessary databases and snapshots (§ 4.1 ), walk with larger L L and K K than the original benchmark, and reverse-generate tasks and verification scripts. After replay and deduplication we obtain AutomationBench Pro (300 tasks) and τ 3 \tau^{3} -Bench Banking Pro (98 tasks). To ensure that Pro benchmarks reflect genuine difficulty rather than task quality, three doctoral-level experts independently reviewed all candidate tasks and their verification scripts over a two-day period. Only tasks approved by at least two experts were retained. Inter-rater agreement was strong, with Fleiss’ κ = 0.82 \kappa=0.82 and an observed agreement of 93.1 % 93.1\% .

blocks.en: Data Statistics. Figure 6 shows that Pro tasks require substantially more tool calls than the standard splits on both benchmarks. On AutomationBench, average tool calls rise sharply for every model, from 26.8–43.6 under Standard to 56.3–60.6 under Pro. On τ 3 \tau^{3} -Bench Banking, average calls likewise rise for every model, from 23.1–32.2 to 27.3–36.3, fully confirming that the added difficulty arises from longer and more frequent tool orchestration.

blocks.en: Trajectory collection and environment synthesis. We collect over 200,000 agent–tool interaction trajectories as raw material for ToolSpace construction, with strict quality control during collection. We perform decontamination at both the task level and the trajectory level: any collected trajectory whose task, tool-call sequence, or initial state overlaps with an evaluation test set is excluded, ensuring that the synthesized data are free of test-set contamination. All data sources and MCP services used are covered by open-source licenses. We mine executable environments following the agentic exploration procedure and settings of Agent-World Dong et al. (2026a) .
blocks.zh: 轨迹收集与环境合成. 我们收集了超过20万个代理工具交互轨道,作为工具空间构建的原材料,收集过程中要严格质量控制。 我们在任务一级和轨迹一级都进行除污工作:任何收集的、其任务、工具调用序列或初始状态与评价测试套件重叠的轨迹都排除在外,确保综合数据不受试验套件污染。 所有数据来源和使用的MCP服务都由开源许可证覆盖。 我们按照Agent-World Dong等人(2026a)的代理勘探程序和设置,开采可执行环境。

blocks.en: Task and trajectory synthesis. We use Kimi K3 (K3) for both teacher-trajectory generation and reverse verifiable task synthesis. All synthesized samples are validated against V V using verification scripts, yielding 34,376 SFT samples and 653 RL samples from the same ToolSpace synthesis pipeline, except that RL candidates undergo additional Pass@16 screening with the 35B model, retaining only candidates with one or two correct rollouts to ensure informative RL training.

blocks.en: (2) ToolSpace exhibits cross-environment long-horizon execution across scales. Gains hold in each domain: ToolSpace-8B leads same-size environment scaling baselines on real productivity suites such as AutomationBench, JobBench, and OfficeQA Pro; ToolSpace-35B-A3B exceeds its Qwen backbone on all seven benchmarks, with AutomationBench rising by more than 35 points (8.2 → \rightarrow 45.8). The pattern persists to 744B: ToolSpace-744B-A40B surpasses GLM 5.3, GPT 5.6 Sol, and its teacher policy K3 on average, and matches Claude Opus 5. These consistent gains across model scales, including performance beyond the teacher, argue against simple capability distillation and instead indicate that ToolSpace teaches transferable tool-composition structure for cross-environment execution.

blocks.en: (3) On-policy agent RL further unlocks capacity. SFT alone lifts ToolSpace by 18.0 points over the 35B backbone (23.0 → \rightarrow 41.0). This indicates that on-policy environment RL can, through exploration, further unlock the multi-tool orchestration potential of SFT-trained models.

blocks.en: Environment Scaling Analysis. To examine whether the breadth of the tool space matters independently of data volume, we fine-tune Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on data synthesized from increasing fractions of ToolSpace environments, from 1 / 16 1/16 to the full environment set. The backbone, training configuration, and evaluation protocol are held fixed, and zero denotes the untuned backbone. Figure 7 (b) reports the results. Despite fluctuations at intermediate fractions, performance improves overall with environment scale and reaches the full-setting optimum, following a clear scaling trend. The increase on AutomationBench between 1 / 16 1/16 and 1 / 8 1/8 is particularly sharp, from 9.2 to 33.8. This suggests that new environment clusters contribute new cross-environment edges, and that space breadth is the limiting factor when coverage is low. In contrast, τ 3 \tau^{3} -Bench Banking improves more slowly under environment scaling, which is consistent with its reliance on a narrower set of stateful banking tools. This supports the central motivation of ToolSpace: performance scales with the breadth of environments that witnessed chains connect. From the perspective of sustained scaling returns, AutomationBench gains about + 4 +4 points per doubling beyond 1 / 8 1/8 on average, despite a plateau between 1 / 4 1/4 and 1 / 2 1/2 , while τ 3 \tau^{3} -Bench Banking shows its largest jump only at the full environment set (19.6 → \to 34.0), indicating that highly connected environment clusters contribute late.

blocks.en: Data Scaling Analysis. To examine whether the benefit of ToolSpace grows with the amount of synthesized data, we fine-tune Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on increasing fractions of the ToolSpace SFT dataset, namely 1 / 16 1/16 , 1 / 8 1/8 , 1 / 4 1/4 , 1 / 2 1/2 , and the full dataset. The backbone, training configuration, and evaluation protocol are held fixed, and zero denotes the untuned backbone. Figure 7 (a) reports the results. Performance improves overall as more data are used, and the full dataset performs best on all five benchmarks. SkillsBench shows a small intermediate decrease from 32.4 at 1 / 16 1/16 to 32.0 at 1 / 8 1/8 . AutomationBench rises from 25.2 at 1 / 16 1/16 to 45.8 with the full dataset, and τ 3 \tau^{3} -Bench Banking rises from 20.6 to 34.0. The gain is therefore not explained by a small set of high-quality examples. Each additional fraction contributes new witnessed tool chains and dependency structures, which is consistent with our motivation that capability grows from the composition space covered by the data. The small decreases below the backbone at the 1 / 16 1/16 fraction on BFCL V4 and OfficeQA Pro indicate interference when the SFT mixture is too small, and the trend becomes stable once the data fraction increases. This demonstrates the scalability of ToolSpace’s synthesized data. From the perspective of sustained scaling returns, the step from 1 / 2 1/2 to the full dataset still improves all five benchmarks (AutomationBench + 4.6 +4.6 ), with no plateau, indicating that the current synthesis scale has not yet hit the returns ceiling of data volume.

blocks.en: Environment Relevance Analysis. To verify that ToolSpace’s gains do not stem from overfitting to benchmark-like environments, we rank environment clusters by relevance to each benchmark using BGE ( Chen et al., 2024 ) embeddings, and compare SFT on (i) the full data, (ii) only the top-50% most relevant environments (Top-50%), and (iii) a random 50% of environments (Random-50%) (Figure 9 (a)). If the gains were driven by benchmark-specific environment fitting, Top-50% should substantially outperform Random-50%. Random-50% uses the same number of environments but excludes many of the most relevant ones. Instead, the two differ by at most 1.7 points on AutomationBench, SkillsBench, BFCL V4, and OfficeQA Pro, and both approach full-data performance using only half the environments. ToolSpace’s gains therefore do not hinge on benchmark-aligned environments, but reflect transferable tool-composition structure.
blocks.zh: 环境相关性分析。 为了证实工具空间的收益并非来自过于适应类似基准的环境,我们使用BGE(Chen等人,2024年)嵌入法将环境集群按与每个基准的相关性排序,并将SFT比较于(一) 全部数据,(二) 只有上50%最相关的环境(Top-50%),(三) 随机50%的环境(Random-50%)(图9(a))。 如果收益是由特定基准环境所驱动的,那么最高50%的业绩应大大超过随机50%。 随机-50%使用同样数量的环境,但不包括许多最相关的环境。 相反,在自动化奔驰,技能奔驰,BFCL V4和OfficeQA Pro上,两者在最多1.7点上存在差异,两者都只使用一半的环境处理全数据性能. 因此,工具空间的收益并不取决于基准环境,而是反映了可转让的工具组合结构。

blocks.en: Task-Synthesis Diversity Visualization. We examine whether ToolSpace spans a broader space of environments and tasks than prior environment-scaling methods by randomly sampling 2k questions from four SFT corpora (EnvScaler, Agent-World, Agent-Reflex, and ToolSpace). We employ BGE-M3 ( Chen et al., 2024 ) as the embedding model, apply t-SNE for dimensionality reduction, and use DBSCAN ( Ester et al., 1996 ) for clustering. As shown in Figure 8 , ToolSpace forms the largest number of question clusters (42), compared with EnvScaler, Agent-World, and Agent-Reflex (25, 31, and 34, respectively), while retaining compact local groupings and broader coverage of the embedding space. This pattern suggests that ToolSpace expands task-space coverage beyond prior environment-scaling methods. We attribute the gain to edge-weighted sampling over observed tool compositions, which connects a wider range of environments.
blocks.zh: 任务合成多样性视觉. 我们通过随机抽样四个SFT公司(EnvScapor, Agent-World, Agent-Reflex,和 ToolSpace)的2k个问题,来研究工具空间是否跨越了比以往环境尺度方法更广泛的环境和任务空间。 我们采用BGE-M3(Chen等人,2024年)作为嵌入模型,应用t-SNE来减小维度,并使用DBSCAN(Ester等人,1996年)来进行集群. 如图8所示,与EnvScale、Agent-World和Agent-Reflex(分别为25个、31个和34个)相比,“工具空间”构成最多的问题分组(42个),同时保留紧凑的本地分组和更广泛的嵌入空间。 这种模式表明,“工具空间”将任务空间的覆盖范围扩大到以往的环境尺度方法之外。 我们将收益归结于边缘加权取样,而不是观测到的工具组成,它们连接了更广泛的环境。

blocks.en: Component Ablation. Beyond which environments are selected and how much they cost to synthesize, we finally examine which ToolSpace components drive the gains. Table 3 reports a component ablation of ToolSpace at 35B, where w/o denotes removing or replacing one specific component. We make three observations. (1) Removing any component degrades all five benchmarks, showing that the components are complementary rather than redundant. (2) The two structural edge types divide the labor: state edges matter most for τ 3 \tau^{3} -Bench Banking and AutomationBench, where state preconditions decide whether a chain is executable at all, while data edges matter most for BFCL V4 and OfficeQA Pro, where argument provenance carries the task. Their comparable average drops (7.1 vs. 7.4 points) fall on disjoint benchmarks, confirming that state dependencies, not data flow alone, enable cross-environment execution. (3) How edges are obtained and traversed matters as much as which edges exist: LLM-judged edges degrade every benchmark almost as much as removing state edges, so edges must be witnessed by execution rather than merely plausible; rollback and edge-weighted sampling contribute in between, and retry edges have the smallest effect, consistent with their role in robustness to noisy tools.

(3) 如何获得边线和通过边线和存在什么边线一样多:LLM判断的边线几乎像去除状态边线一样降解每个基准线,因此边缘必须用执行来见证,而不是仅仅看似合理;回滚和边重采样在两者之间起到作用,而复试边缘的作用最小,这与它们在强力到噪音工具的作用是一致的。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we present ToolSpace, a tool-centric framework for cross-environment agent data synthesis. ToolSpace mines data, state, and retry dependencies between adjacent calls in execution traces from real MCP services and open agent corpora, using deterministic rules rather than LLM judgment, and clusters the resulting weighted tool-composition graph into environments. Databases are synthesized only for state-mutating environments, while query and stateless tools replay recorded returns. ToolSpace then performs state-aware random walks with rollback and decompiles each chain into a natural-language task with assertion-based checks, keeping only samples that replay successfully from the initial state. Applied to AutomationBench and τ 3 \tau^{3} -Bench Banking, the pipeline produces harder Pro versions on which seven frontier models drop by up to 38.2 points. Across seven long-horizon tool-use benchmarks, ToolSpace raises Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from 23.0 to 41.0 average score (43.2 with RL) and GLM-5.2 from 44.6 to 56.6, on par with Claude Opus 5. Ablations show that execution-witnessed edges clearly outperform LLM-judged ones, and performance keeps improving with data and environment scale.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了工具空间,这是一个以工具为中心的跨环境剂数据合成框架。 ToolSpace 矿井数据、状态和重试在从真正的 MCP 服务和开源代理公司发出的执行痕迹中的相邻呼叫之间的依赖性,使用确定性规则而不是LLM 判断,并将由此产生的加权工具组合图分组到环境中。 数据库只针对状态变换环境进行合成,而查询和无国籍工具则重放记录的返回. ToolSpace然后以回滚方式进行状态意识随机行走,将每个链条分解为自然语言任务,并进行基于断言的检查,只保留从初始状态成功重播的样本. 用于自动化奔驰和\tau^{3}\tau^{3}——奔驰银行,管道生产更硬的Pro版本,七个前沿型号下降38.2点. 在7个长视距工具使用基准中,TollectSpace将Qwen3.6-35B-A3B从23.0提高到41.0平均分(43.2与RL),GLM-5.2从44.6提高到56.6,与克劳德·奥普斯5持平. 差距表明,被处决的目击证人的优势明显高于LLM判断的优势,而且随着数据和环境尺度的扩大,性能不断提高。
